sections.title: About Track Night
sections.intro: Track Night is a modern race car's screen: a ladder of bars across the top, the reading huge on an electric-blue band, and shift lights that close in from both sides as it climbs.

items.alt: The Track Night style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Track Night, drawn by the app itself

items.title: €2.39, once
items.text: Buy Track Night once on Google Play and it's yours. On a new phone with the same Google account, it comes back by itself.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Track Night's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.

image.alt: The Torque style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Torque
items.text: A muscle-car dash: a curved rev arc with a red shift zone, a big round dial on gunmetal, the time as a framed gear number, and fuel and temperature arcs.

image.alt: The Circuit style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Circuit
items.text: The track look: glowing blue sweeps on deep black, three small round gauges between the rev arc and the dial, and crisp thin digits.

image.alt: The Prism style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Prism
items.text: An angular tech cluster: two slanted panels of faceted glass, blue for the reading and red for the revs, with tilted bar scales and a thin neon outline.

image.alt: The Aura style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Aura
items.text: Premium sport dials: chrome rings, a warm glow behind white numerals and big digital numbers, on graphite leather.
